title: Marketplace Settlement Reconciliation
summary: Reconcile Amazon, Flipkart and other marketplace settlements order by order, including commissions, fees, returns, reimbursements, TCS and TDS, and find what the marketplace still owes you.

seo.title: Marketplace Settlement Reconciliation | VipraTech
seo.description: Reconcile Amazon, Flipkart and other marketplace settlements order by order, check fees and returns against rate cards, and find money still owed.

problem.intro: Brands that sell on marketplaces receive settlements that net off commissions, shipping and storage fees, returns, cancellations, reimbursements and taxes. Each marketplace reports this in its own files, and the totals rarely match the orders in your books. Fees charged above the rate card and returns that never came back quietly reduce margin.

pain_points.title: Settlements that do not tie to orders
pain_points.detail: One payout covers thousands of orders, returns and fees, and tying it back to your sales register takes days.

pain_points.title: Fees above the rate card
pain_points.detail: Commission, shipping weight slabs and storage fees are charged at the wrong rate or on the wrong category.

pain_points.title: Returns that never came back
pain_points.detail: Customer returns are refunded but the product never reaches your warehouse, or comes back damaged, and the claim window passes.

pain_points.title: TCS and TDS to match
pain_points.detail: Tax collected and deducted by the marketplace has to match your books and tax statements, settlement by settlement.

solution.overview: VipraTech reads each marketplace's settlement, order, return and fee reports and ties every settlement line to an order in your sales register. Fees are recalculated from the rate card for the category, weight and fulfilment type, and charges above the rate card are flagged. Returns are matched to what your warehouse actually received, so missing or damaged returns are listed with the evidence a reimbursement claim needs, before the window closes. TCS and TDS are reconciled with your books.
capabilities: Ties every settlement line to an order, return or fee
Recalculates fees from each marketplace's rate card
Matches refunded returns to warehouse receipts
Lists reimbursement claims with evidence and deadlines
Reconciles TCS and TDS with your books
Order-level margin after all marketplace charges

workflow.title: Tie to orders
workflow.detail: Every settlement line is matched to an order or return in your sales register.

workflow.title: Check fees
workflow.detail: Fees are recalculated from the rate card and compared with what was charged.

workflow.title: Check returns
workflow.detail: Refunded returns are matched to warehouse receipts and their condition.

workflow.title: Review
workflow.detail: Finance reviews overcharges and missing returns.

workflow.title: Claim and track
workflow.detail: Reimbursement claims are prepared with evidence and tracked to closure.

match_rules.logic: Each delivered order must appear in a settlement within the marketplace's payment cycle.
Commission, fixed and shipping fees are recalculated from the rate card, category and weight slab on the order date.
Each customer return must show as received in your warehouse, in the condition the marketplace reports.
Returns not received, or received damaged, must carry a reimbursement, or a claim is prepared.
Each settlement total must match the bank credit for that cycle.

exception_codes.meaning: A delivered order has no settlement after the cycle.
exception_codes.action: Raise a ticket with the order list.

exception_codes.meaning: A fee is above the rate card.
exception_codes.action: Raise a claim with the recalculation.

exception_codes.meaning: A refunded return never reached the warehouse.
Shipping was charged on a higher weight slab.
The settlement total and the bank credit differ.

inputs: Settlement, order, return and fee reports from each marketplace
outputs: Settlements tied to orders, returns and fees
Missing or damaged returns with claim evidence and deadlines
human_in_the_loop: Finance reviews overcharges and missing returns and decides which reimbursement claims to file. The system prepares the evidence; your team submits the claims.
guardrails: Every flagged fee shows the rate card line used
Claim deadlines tracked for each marketplace
Claims filed only after finance approves them
No settlement marked reconciled with unexplained lines
compliance_notes: TCS collected by e-commerce operators and TDS deducted on payouts must match your returns and tax statements; the system reconciles both settlement by settlement.

rollout.scope: One marketplace, using the last two to three months of settlements, with your sales register and warehouse receipts.
deliverables: Fee checks against the rate card

what_we_measure.how: Share of settlement lines tied to an order, return or fee.
Value of missing or damaged returns found within the claim window.

faqs.a: Amazon and Flipkart first, then others such as Myntra, Nykaa, Meesho and Ajio, depending on where you sell most.

faqs.q: Do you need our seller account login?
faqs.a: No. Report exports are enough to start. Automating downloads can come later, with your approval.

faqs.q: Can it file reimbursement claims for us?
faqs.a: It prepares each claim with the order, return and evidence. Your team files it and the system tracks the outcome.

faqs.q: How long does it take to go live?
faqs.a: About 8 weeks from the first files to go-live. The first cycle runs beside your current process on your own data, and your team switches over once the results agree with what it would have settled.
